description: Starting state shared by all 1,000 simulations. No 2025-26 result is part of it.

league_goals_per_match.source: Stage 4 neutral default league_goals = mean total goals per match over the 10 training seasons (data/processed/feature_params.json). The Stage 5d pre-season table used 2.934 (2024-25); 2.83 was specified for Stage 7.

neutral_goal_defaults.source: data/processed/goal_feature_params.json (training rows only); used for a league average over fewer than 20 simulated matches

features_built: 8 relative goal features (last 10 overall, last 10 at the venue)
features_not_built: points, shots, head-to-head and matches-played features: the saved Poisson model does not use them
